title: The Prize Cheddar Wheel
scene: At 10:25 AM, the aged cheddar wheel vanished from the cellar. The 10:00 AM milk train takes 40 minutes to reach Meadowbrook.

suspects.name: Bonnie Fletcher
suspects.testimony: I wiped wooden shelves right beside the cellar door from 10:10 to 10:30 AM.
suspects.alibiProof: Two farmhands carried crates past Bonnie wiping shelves by the cellar from 10:10 to 10:30 AM.

suspects.name: Yara Bakir
suspects.testimony: I braided brioche loaves in the kitchen from 10:05 to 10:30 AM and never went downstairs.
suspects.alibiProof: The dairy's delivery driver watched Yara braiding loaves in the kitchen from 10:05 to 10:30 AM.

suspects.name: Martin Tanner
suspects.testimony: I boarded the 10:00 AM milk train and was already tasting jams at Meadowbrook by 10:20 AM.
suspects.contradiction: The 10:00 AM train doesn't reach Meadowbrook until 10:40 AM, and the cheddar was in Martin's crate.

suspects.name: Wallace Griffin
suspects.testimony: I washed milk cans in the yard from 10:00 to 10:30 AM, whistling to the barn cat.
suspects.alibiProof: The mail carrier waved to Wallace washing milk cans in the yard at 10:10 and 10:25 AM.
